title: End-to-end Richards provider replay
question: Can a frozen hybrid hydraulic lookup replace only the constitutive evaluation layer of the Reference Richards solve while preserving accepted hydrological behavior and reducing total solve cost?

reason: B1.10 capacity has a timestep-dependent near-saturation floor for h > -1 cm.
Keeping h > -1 cm analytical makes the frozen lookup independent of timestep/retry changes.
Near-saturation and branch-switch semantics remain exact rather than interpolated.

candidates: fixed 50-point log-head lookup with exact h > -1 cm fallback
fixed 100-point log-head lookup with exact h > -1 cm fallback
adaptive error-controlled lookup with exact h > -1 cm fallback

stage_A.fixture: FSI24 Gate-C nonlinear B1.10 Richards case
stage_A.purpose: solver-response identity/fidelity screen before broad timing

stage_B_after_stage_A_pass.purpose: runtime and trajectory comparison on multiple materials/cases

acceptance_policy.reason: The lookup is an approximation and must be judged against preregistered physical/numerical error gates rather than falsely requiring identical floating-point arithmetic.
